Transparent Methodology

How ThinkRight Rankings Work

1

3-Test Qualification Minimum

To prevent lucky single-test anomalies, candidates must complete at least 3 valid practice tests during the active week to enter the national standings.

2

Recency-Weighted Projection

Your projected score out of 400 is calculated with heavier weight on your most recent performances (up to 35% on your latest test), rewarding active improvement.

3

Official JAMB Curve Calibration

Raw percentage scores are mapped through ThinkRight's empirical JAMB calibration algorithm (0.85 scaling factor) to reflect actual UTME grading difficulty.

4

Weekly Reset Cycle

Every Sunday at 23:59:59 UTC, the competition resets for a brand-new weekly season, giving every candidate a fresh opportunity to claim the #1 spot.
